Name: (CP) Slightly Hotter Wizard Seasonal
Author: txndercby
Description:
[b]//SHWS Expanded[/b]
Replaces Magnus portraits and sprites with slightly hotter seasonal versions. Includes options to configure facial hair (Regular, Stache, Shaven, & Beard Glamour.)

Requires [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]. 
Designed to work with spacechase0's [url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and Poltergeister's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url]

[b]//SHWS[/b] (for base game)
Replaces Wizard portraits and sprites with slightly hotter seasonal versions. Includes options to configure facial hair (Regular, Stache, Shaven.)

Designed to work with spacechase0's [url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and Poltergeister's [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url]


[b]Configs:[/b]

"SlightlyHotterWizard": "True, False"
Set to true if you want the mod to be loaded, set to false if you do not.

"FacialHair": "Regular, Mustache, Shaven" (+ Expanded only "Beard Glamour", Magnus's beard reappears when he gets flustered lol)
Decides what facial hair the Wizard has.

"NoNose": "True, False"
Set to true if you don't want the Wizard to have a nose, set to false if you do.

"FestivalOutfits": "True, False" [b]**Expanded only[/b]
Set to true if you want Magnus to wear festival clothes to the flower dance, set to false if you do not.


[b]Mods pictured:[/b][list]
[*][url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0 [b]highly recommend - makes config easier[/b]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6166]Overgrown Flowery Interface[/url] by 36maraluna
[*][url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour[/url] by Daisy Niko
[/list]﻿
Big thank you to Poltergeister and other artists that worked on [url=http://https//www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] as it inspired this one! :)
